summary: @jtbartles love to bend your ear for a few and ask about the backend questions. Ten years ago it was, "Do we really need researchers who blog and use social media?" In retrospect the answer was yes. This is no different. Just a decade later. #lra18
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @jtbartles love to bend your ear for a few and ask about the backend questions. Ten years ago it was, "Do we really need researchers who blog and use social media?" In retrospect the answer was yes. This is no different. Just a decade later. #lra18
